description: This file is an implementation of the BankingService interface, providing CRUD operations for customers and accounts, as well as monetary transactions such as deposit, withdrawal, and transfer within a banking application. It interacts with repositories and employs helper methods for entity conversions and validations.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the BankingService interface, providing the core logic for customer and account management, as well as transaction processing in a banking system.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer entry in the repository from given customer details.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by ID, returning an Optional.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Returns a list of all customers.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer's details identified by customer ID.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer by ID, if exists.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a specified customer, possibly linking to customer entity.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Retrieves account details by account ID.

methods.name: updateAccount
methods.description: Updates details of an existing account.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deletes an account if it exists.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Deposits a specified amount into an account, recording the transaction.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.description: Withdraws a specified amount from an account, with funds validation and transaction recording.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Transfers funds between two accounts, with validation, atomic update, and transaction records.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves list of transactions for a particular account.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Returns the current balance of an account.

methods.name: getBalancesForCustomer
methods.description: Fetches balances for all accounts linked to a customer.
